paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Prompt Depth and Accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Prompt Depth (J)" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 2 to 10 at intervals of 2, while the plotted data points occur at x-values of 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 74 to 81 at intervals of 1. The plot displays two lines. The "mmsd" series is depicted by a dashed orange line with square markers; it begins at an x-value of 1 with an accuracy of approximately 80.0%, remains relatively stable across x-values of 3, 5, and 7 with values near 80.3%, 80.2%, and 80.1% respectively, reaches a peak of roughly 81.3% at an x-value of 9, and then declines to end at approximately 80.1% at an x-value of 11. The "mmsd2" series is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at an x-value of 1 with an accuracy of approximately 76.5%, declines sharply to a minimum of 74.0% at an x-value of 3, rises steadily to 76.0% at an x-value of 5 and 77.5% at an x-value of 7, reaches a peak of approximately 77.6% at an x-value of 9, and finally decreases to end at roughly 76.7% at an x-value of 11.
